device.label: Battery device
device.description: auto, a sysfs battery name such as BAT0, or an absolute sysfs path

design_capacity_mwh.label: Design capacity (mWh)
design_capacity_mwh.description: 0 = auto: a cached SMBIOS value, a direct SMBIOS read, then the firmware's energy_full_design. Set a value only to override auto-detection.

auto_detect_design.label: Auto-detect design capacity
auto_detect_design.description: When the firmware reports the full-charge capacity as the design capacity, ask once (polkit) to read the real value from SMBIOS Type 22 and cache it. Requires pkexec and dmidecode.

smoothing_window_min.label: Rate averaging window (minutes)
smoothing_window_min.description: Least-squares window used for the power and time estimate. Longer is steadier, shorter reacts sooner.

show_label.label: Show label
show_label.description: Show the text next to the battery glyph

label_content.label: Label content
label_content.description: What the label shows on a horizontal bar

hide_when_plugged.label: Hide when plugged in
hide_when_plugged.description: Hide the widget while the charger is connected

hide_when_full.label: Hide when full
hide_when_full.description: Hide the widget when the battery is fully charged

show_health.label: Show health
show_health.description: Show battery health in the tooltip

warning_color.label: Warning color
warning_color.description: Color used at or below the global battery warning threshold

notify.detect_missing: pkexec or dmidecode is not installed, so the design capacity cannot be read from SMBIOS.
notify.detect_failed: Could not read the design capacity from SMBIOS. Set it manually in the plugin settings.
notify.detect_ok: Design capacity detected: {capacity} Wh. Health now uses the real value.
